title: Features
body:
Nightcap adds these systems to Classic EverQuest.

Adventures and quests

  • Raid and Grind dungeons — Choose from 21 Classic dungeons. Raid enemies stay dead. Grind enemies respawn.
  • Custom helmet quests — Earn a Paladin helmet through Camil’s Vigil or a Shadow Knight helmet through The Ashen Compact.
  • Zone Hunt — Find custom equipment and augments. Combine matching rewards to improve their quality.
  • Ascended epics — Improve an earned class epic with Essence of Ascension and platinum.
  • The Last Lantern — Begin at level 20. Complete story chapters and earn an armor outfit.

Character and combat

  • Three classes — Keep your starting class. Choose two extra classes from level 1.
  • AA progression — Earn two AA per level. Allocate up to 100% of eligible experience to AA.
  • Multiple pets — Summon several pets. Control one pet or all pets.
  • Classic sympathetic clicks — Two Ascended jewelry pieces grant extra damage or healing on eligible spells.
  • Bow damage — Heroic Dexterity increases damage from ordinary bow shots.
  • Backstab weapons — Backstab can use a one-handed piercing weapon in either hand.
  • Combat rules — Cast while you attack. Cast DoTs instantly. Normal death preserves experience and belongings.
  • Solo self-found — Choose a permanent level-1 oath. Player trading, groups and passive AA are disabled.
  • Quick Buff — Cast memorized buffs for 50% of maximum mana. There is no reuse delay.
  • Titles — Select cosmetic titles for kills, dungeon completion and skill mastery. Matching prefixes and suffixes unlock automatically, with a notification.

Equipment and world

  • Equipment qualities — Find Normal, Polished, Exalted and Ascended equipment. Trade items and keep duplicates.
  • Item upgrades — Combine matching copies with the Reforging Box or Zone Hunt forging. Check the recipe first.
  • Tradeskills — Use Craft All to repeat a recipe while materials remain.
  • Waypoints — Discover travel locations and return to them.
  • Commonlands services — Find class trainers, merchants, free buffs and travel services in the tunnel.

Tools

  • Loot finder — Filter equipment by class, slot, quality and drop zone.
  • Build Lab — Compare equipment stats and spell priorities.
  • Advanced loot — Set item filters and control your loot.
  • Launcher and interface — Update through the Nightcap launcher before play.

The Ashen Compact · Keyless doors · Commands

Classic focus equipment

Earn spell haste, healing and mana-preservation gear from Classic dungeons and raids. The effects retain spell limits and strongest-focus rules.

Classic defensive equipment

Classic defensive drops offer more equipment choices from early dungeons through the planes.

Worn dodge and parry/block follow strongest-effect rules. Small head and boot regeneration effects support recovery during combat.
